en.title: 88% of Banks Have Tried AI, Only 4% Have Formal Governance: The Gap Bank Indonesia Flags
en.dek: An IBM and Perbanas study found that almost every bank in Indonesia has tried AI, but only 4% have formally built it into corporate governance. Bank Indonesia warns of risks missing from older risk manuals, including AI agents behaving in lockstep.
en.dataLabel: of banks in Indonesia have formally integrated AI into corporate governance
en.seoTitle: 88% of Indonesian Banks Try AI, Only 4% Have Governance
en.seoDescription: IBM-Perbanas study: almost every Indonesian bank has tried AI, but governance lags. Bank Indonesia flags deepfake and herding risks.
en.summaryHtml:
• An IBM and Perbanas study shows 88% of banks in Indonesia have tried AI technology, while 12% have not started. Only 4% have formally integrated AI into corporate governance. (Indonesia Business Post)
  • The findings were released with the white paper “Digital Sovereign AI and the Future of Trusted Banking” by IBM, Perbanas and Kiantara & Associates on 27 October 2026. (Indonesia Business Post)
  • Juvanus Tjandra, Managing Partner of IBM Consulting Indonesia, said AI adoption in the industry is still fragmented and many banks lack a centralized architecture. Use is concentrated in customer service, such as chatbots. (Indonesia Business Post)
  • Ricky Satria of Bank Indonesia warned of fraud using synthetic voices and faces, and of attacks that now unfold within hours rather than weeks. (Katadata)
  • Bank Indonesia also highlighted herding risk: many AI agents using the same models and cloud providers can give similar recommendations at the same time. It urged banks to keep full control over the AI they use. (Katadata)
en.analysisHtml:
AI came in through the front door; governance is trailing behind

The gap between 88% and 4% shows a common pattern: AI is first used in chatbots and customer service because results show quickly. Governance is considered only after use has spread. In banking this order is risky, because AI models that touch customer data and credit decisions are under strict supervision.

Herding is a new risk missing from older risk manuals

Traditional risk management assesses one model at one bank. Herding risk comes from many banks using the same models and data sources. If the model is wrong, the error happens everywhere at once. Provider diversity and the ability to switch off AI agents quickly are therefore likely to become part of supervision.

Sovereign AI will change how banks buy technology

Bank Indonesia's push for banks to keep full control over AI points to a preference for models that can run on their own or domestic infrastructure. BNI, for example, has already developed on-premise generative AI based on open-source models with Cloudera. Vendors that only offer services from abroad will face more questions in procurement.
en.actionHtml:
For banks and financial services firms

  1. List every AI system in use, including those bought separately by business units.
  2. Bring AI models into the model risk management framework, with owners, testing and monitoring.
  3. Limit AI agents' access to customer data and transactions, and prepare a kill switch to stop them.
  4. Review dependence on a single model or cloud provider.

For solution providers

The biggest needs are AI governance tools, model monitoring, deepfake detection for customer verification, and deploying AI on local infrastructure that meets data sovereignty requirements.
en.faqHtml:
What is herding risk in AI?

The risk that many AI systems using the same models and data make similar decisions at the same time. Under market stress, this can amplify shocks.

articles.title: Biaya Token Melonjak, 89% Perusahaan Rancang Ulang AI: Apa Artinya bagi Perusahaan Indonesia
articles.dek: Survei Cloudera terhadap 1.500 pemimpin TI menemukan 89% perusahaan membatasi atau merancang ulang kasus penggunaan AI karena konsumsi token meningkat. Di Indonesia, investasi AI justru terus naik. Pertanyaannya bergeser dari apakah memakai AI menjadi berapa biaya untuk setiap hasil.
articles.summaryHtml:
• Laporan Cloudera “The State of Enterprise AI 2026: The New Rules of Scale” menyurvei 1.500 pemimpin TI di sejumlah negara. Survei dilakukan Wakefield Research pada September 2026. (IndoTelko)
  • Secara global, 89% responden membatasi atau merancang ulang kasus penggunaan AI karena konsumsi token meningkat, dan 45% memindahkan beban kerja AI karena biaya yang lebih tinggi atau berfluktuasi. (IndoTelko)
  • Di Indonesia, 88% perusahaan menambah investasi AI dibanding tahun sebelumnya, dan 70% mengalokasikan setidaknya US$500.000 per tahun. Hambatan terbesar adalah tata kelola dan kepatuhan (65%), kekurangan keahlian (55%), serta integrasi data (45%). (IndoTelko)
  • Lokasi dan yurisdiksi data memengaruhi penempatan beban kerja AI bagi 88% organisasi Indonesia. (IndoTelko)
  • Survei CEO PwC Indonesia 2026 menunjukkan 22% CEO melihat kenaikan pendapatan dari AI dan 28% melihat penurunan biaya, tetapi hanya 10% merasakan keduanya. (Fortune IDN)
articles.analysisHtml:
Biaya inferensi adalah biaya operasional baru

Lisensi perangkat lunak biasanya tetap per pengguna. Biaya model AI berbeda: setiap pertanyaan, setiap dokumen yang dibaca, dan setiap langkah agen AI memakan token. Ketika penggunaan meluas ke seluruh perusahaan, tagihan ikut membesar. Agen AI yang menjalankan banyak langkah otomatis bisa melipatgandakan konsumsi tanpa terlihat oleh pengguna.

Investasi naik, tetapi hasil belum merata

Angka 88% perusahaan Indonesia yang menambah investasi AI terlihat positif. Namun, data PwC menunjukkan baru 10% CEO yang merasakan kenaikan pendapatan sekaligus penurunan biaya. Selisih ini menandakan banyak proyek AI belum diukur dengan satuan ekonomi yang jelas, misalnya biaya per tiket layanan yang terselesaikan.

Kedaulatan data ikut menentukan biaya

Bagi 88% organisasi Indonesia, lokasi data memengaruhi di mana AI dijalankan. Model yang harus berjalan di dalam negeri atau di infrastruktur sendiri punya struktur biaya berbeda dari layanan cloud publik. Keputusan arsitektur ini sebaiknya dibuat bersama tim keuangan, bukan hanya tim TI.
articles.actionHtml:
Untuk CIO, CDO, dan CFO

  1. Tetapkan metrik biaya per hasil untuk setiap kasus penggunaan AI, bukan hanya total anggaran.
  2. Gunakan model kecil untuk tugas sederhana dan model besar hanya untuk tugas yang memang membutuhkannya.
  3. Pasang pemantauan konsumsi token per aplikasi dan per tim sebelum skala diperluas.
  4. Bangun tata kelola sejak awal: 49% responden global mengatakan akan melakukannya jika bisa mengulang dari awal.

Untuk penyedia solusi AI

Pembeli enterprise akan semakin menuntut prediktabilitas biaya. Paket harga yang jelas, opsi penerapan di infrastruktur lokal, serta dasbor pemakaian akan menjadi pembeda dalam proses pengadaan.
articles.faqHtml:
Apa itu token dalam AI?

Token adalah satuan teks yang diproses model AI. Biaya layanan model bahasa umumnya dihitung berdasarkan jumlah token yang masuk dan keluar.

en.title: Token Costs Soar, 89% of Companies Redesign AI: What It Means for Indonesian Enterprises
en.dek: A Cloudera survey of 1,500 IT leaders found that 89% of companies are limiting or redesigning AI use cases as token consumption rises. In Indonesia, AI investment keeps climbing. The question is shifting from whether to use AI to what each result costs.
en.dataLabel: of companies limit or redesign AI use cases as token consumption rises
en.dataSource: Cloudera, The State of Enterprise AI 2026 (survey of 1,500 IT leaders)
en.seoTitle: 89% of Firms Redesign AI as Token Costs Soar
en.seoDescription: Cloudera survey: token costs force companies to redesign AI, while AI investment in Indonesia keeps rising. The steps enterprises should take.
en.summaryHtml:
• Cloudera's report “The State of Enterprise AI 2026: The New Rules of Scale” surveyed 1,500 IT leaders in several countries. Wakefield Research conducted the survey in September 2026. (IndoTelko)
  • Globally, 89% of respondents are limiting or redesigning AI use cases as token consumption rises, and 45% have moved AI workloads because of higher or fluctuating costs. (IndoTelko)
  • In Indonesia, 88% of companies increased AI investment from the previous year, and 70% allocate at least US$500,000 a year. The biggest obstacles are governance and compliance (65%), skills shortages (55%) and data integration (45%). (IndoTelko)
  • Data location and jurisdiction affect where AI workloads are placed for 88% of Indonesian organizations. (IndoTelko)
  • PwC Indonesia's 2026 CEO Survey shows 22% of CEOs see revenue gains from AI and 28% see cost reductions, but only 10% see both. (Fortune IDN)
en.analysisHtml:
Inference costs are a new operating expense

Software licenses are usually fixed per user. AI model costs are different: every question, every document read and every step an AI agent takes consumes tokens. As use spreads across the company, the bill grows with it. AI agents that run many automated steps can multiply consumption without users noticing.

Investment is rising, but results are uneven

The 88% of Indonesian companies increasing AI investment looks positive. Yet PwC's data shows only 10% of CEOs see higher revenue and lower costs at the same time. The gap suggests many AI projects are not yet measured in clear unit economics, such as the cost per resolved service ticket.

Data sovereignty also shapes cost

For 88% of Indonesian organizations, data location affects where AI runs. Models that must run in the country or on in-house infrastructure have a different cost structure from public cloud services. This architecture decision is best made together with finance, not by IT alone.
en.actionHtml:
For CIOs, CDOs and CFOs

  1. Set a cost-per-outcome metric for every AI use case, not just a total budget.
  2. Use small models for simple tasks and large models only where they are really needed.
  3. Monitor token consumption per application and per team before scaling up.
  4. Build governance from the start: 49% of global respondents say they would do so if they could start over.

For AI solution providers

Enterprise buyers will increasingly demand predictable costs. Clear pricing, options to deploy on local infrastructure and usage dashboards will set vendors apart in procurement.
en.faqHtml:
What is a token in AI?

A token is a unit of text processed by an AI model. Language model services are usually priced by the number of tokens going in and out.

articles.title: Equinix Tambah 1.125 Kabinet di JK1 Jakarta: Kapasitas Data Center Siap AI Mulai Jadi Rebutan
articles.dek: Equinix meresmikan JK1 Phase 2 di Jakarta dengan tambahan sekitar 1.125 kabinet berpendingin cair. Equinix memperkirakan sebagian besar ruang data hall terisi dalam enam bulan. Bagi perusahaan yang berencana menjalankan beban kerja AI, ini sinyal untuk mengamankan kapasitas lebih awal.
articles.summaryHtml:
• Equinix meresmikan JK1 Phase 2 di Jakarta pada 10 November 2026. Ekspansi ini menambah sekitar 1.125 kabinet sehingga total JK1 mencapai sekitar 1.660 kabinet. Belanja modal tahap ini diperkirakan US$39 juta, dan total komitmen investasi Equinix di Indonesia menjadi US$94 juta. (Bisnis.com)
  • JK1 Phase 2 dilengkapi kapasitas siap AI dengan pendingin cair (liquid cooling) dan ditargetkan beroperasi pada kuartal IV/2026. (Bisnis.com)
  • Managing Director Equinix Indonesia Haris Izmee memperkirakan sebagian besar data hall akan terisi dalam enam bulan. Permintaan datang dari AI, minyak dan gas, pertambangan, serta perbankan. (Fortune IDN)
  • Menurut Haris, “AI mendorong permintaan akan infrastruktur siap AI yang saling terkoneksi dan berdekatan dengan cloud.” JK1 terhubung ke AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, dan Alibaba Cloud. (Katadata)
  • Komdigi menyebut kapasitas pusat data Indonesia saat ini sekitar 600 MW. Wamenkomdigi Nezar Patria membandingkannya dengan Malaysia, yang menurutnya sudah mencapai sekitar 3 GW. (Katadata, Fortune IDN)
articles.analysisHtml:
Yang penting bukan jumlah kabinet, melainkan pendingin cair

Server GPU untuk AI menghasilkan panas jauh lebih besar per rak dibanding server biasa. Pendingin udara konvensional sulit menanganinya. Karena itu, label “siap AI” pada JK1 Phase 2 lebih bermakna daripada angka 1.125 kabinet. Tidak semua fasilitas di Jakarta mampu menampung rak AI berdaya tinggi.

Kapasitas bisa habis lebih cepat dari rencana TI perusahaan

Perkiraan bahwa data hall terisi dalam enam bulan menunjukkan permintaan sudah ada sebelum gedung beroperasi. Permintaan juga tidak hanya dari perusahaan AI, tetapi dari sektor tradisional seperti pertambangan dan perbankan. Perusahaan yang baru mulai merencanakan beban kerja AI tahun depan bisa mendapati kapasitas siap AI di lokasi strategis sudah dipesan pihak lain.

600 MW versus 3 GW: Indonesia masih mengejar Malaysia

Selisih kapasitas dengan Malaysia menjelaskan mengapa sebagian beban kerja regional dilayani dari Johor. Namun, aturan kedaulatan dan lokasi data mendorong banyak perusahaan Indonesia menjalankan beban kerja sensitif di dalam negeri. Kedua faktor ini membuat kapasitas domestik yang siap AI menjadi aset yang langka dalam dua sampai tiga tahun ke depan.
articles.actionHtml:
Untuk CIO dan kepala infrastruktur

  1. Petakan beban kerja AI yang wajib berada di Indonesia karena alasan data pribadi atau regulasi sektor.
  2. Hitung kebutuhan rak berdaya tinggi untuk 12–24 bulan ke depan, lalu bicarakan reservasi kapasitas lebih awal.
  3. Rancang konektivitas langsung ke penyedia cloud yang sudah dipakai untuk menekan latensi dan biaya transfer data.
  4. Minta bukti klaim keberlanjutan, seperti sistem pendingin tertutup dan sumber energi, untuk kebutuhan pelaporan ESG.

Untuk penyedia solusi

Peluang terbesar ada pada layanan yang mengurangi beban perusahaan untuk membangun sendiri: GPU sebagai layanan, migrasi beban kerja ke colocation, manajemen jaringan hybrid cloud, serta dukungan teknis untuk sistem pendingin cair.
articles.faqHtml:
Kapan JK1 Phase 2 mulai beroperasi?

Equinix menargetkan JK1 Phase 2 beroperasi pada kuartal IV/2026.

Berapa total investasi Equinix di Indonesia?

Dengan ekspansi ini, total komitmen investasi Equinix di Indonesia menjadi US$94 juta.

en.title: Equinix Adds 1,125 Cabinets at JK1 Jakarta: AI-Ready Data Center Capacity Becomes Contested
en.dek: Equinix opened JK1 Phase 2 in Jakarta, adding about 1,125 liquid-cooled cabinets. Equinix expects most of the data hall space to be filled within six months. For companies planning AI workloads, it is a signal to secure capacity early.
en.dataLabel: new liquid-cooled cabinets at Equinix JK1 Phase 2
en.seoTitle: Equinix JK1 Phase 2: AI-Ready Data Center in Jakarta
en.seoDescription: Equinix adds 1,125 liquid-cooled cabinets at JK1 Jakarta. What it means for companies planning AI workloads in Indonesia.
en.summaryHtml:
• Equinix opened JK1 Phase 2 in Jakarta on 10 November 2026. The expansion adds about 1,125 cabinets, bringing JK1 to about 1,660 cabinets in total. Capital expenditure for this phase is estimated at US$39 million, and Equinix's total investment commitment in Indonesia reaches US$94 million. (Bisnis.com)
  • JK1 Phase 2 includes AI-ready capacity with liquid cooling and is targeted to operate in Q4 2026. (Bisnis.com)
  • Haris Izmee, Managing Director of Equinix Indonesia, expects most of the data hall to be filled within six months. Demand comes from AI, oil and gas, mining and banking. (Fortune IDN)
  • According to Haris, AI is driving demand for AI-ready infrastructure that is interconnected and close to the cloud. JK1 connects to AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud. (Katadata)
  • Komdigi puts Indonesia's current data center capacity at about 600 MW. Deputy Minister Nezar Patria compared it with Malaysia, which he said has reached about 3 GW. (Katadata, Fortune IDN)
en.analysisHtml:
What matters is not the cabinet count but the liquid cooling

GPU servers for AI generate far more heat per rack than ordinary servers. Conventional air cooling struggles to handle it. The “AI-ready” label on JK1 Phase 2 therefore means more than the figure of 1,125 cabinets. Not every facility in Jakarta can host high-power AI racks.

Capacity may run out faster than companies' IT plans

The expectation that the data hall fills within six months shows demand existed before the building opened. Demand also comes not only from AI companies but from traditional sectors such as mining and banking. Companies that only start planning AI workloads for next year may find AI-ready capacity in strategic locations already booked.

600 MW versus 3 GW: Indonesia is still catching up with Malaysia

The capacity gap with Malaysia explains why some regional workloads are served from Johor. However, data sovereignty and location rules push many Indonesian companies to run sensitive workloads in the country. Together, these factors make domestic AI-ready capacity a scarce asset over the next two to three years.
en.actionHtml:
For CIOs and heads of infrastructure

  1. Map the AI workloads that must stay in Indonesia for personal data or sector regulation reasons.
  2. Estimate high-power rack needs for the next 12–24 months, then discuss capacity reservations early.
  3. Design direct connectivity to the cloud providers already in use to cut latency and data transfer costs.
  4. Ask for evidence behind sustainability claims, such as closed-loop cooling and energy sources, for ESG reporting.

For solution providers

The biggest opportunities are in services that spare companies from building it themselves: GPU as a service, migrating workloads to colocation, hybrid cloud network management and technical support for liquid cooling systems.
en.faqHtml:
When does JK1 Phase 2 start operating?

Equinix targets operation of JK1 Phase 2 in Q4 2026.

How much has Equinix invested in Indonesia?

With this expansion, Equinix's total investment commitment in Indonesia reaches US$94 million.

articles.title: 2,2 Juta Serangan Siber ke Indonesia dalam 24 Jam: Membaca Angka di Balik Kepanikan
articles.dek: Jumlah percobaan serangan siber ke Indonesia di dashboard FortiGuard Labs naik dari sekitar 350.600 menjadi 2,2 juta dalam tiga hari. Angka itu nyata, tetapi bukan jumlah sistem yang jebol. Risiko terbesar bagi perusahaan justru ada di tempat lain.
articles.summaryHtml:
• Dashboard FortiGuard Labs mencatat sekitar 350.600 percobaan serangan dalam 24 jam per 7 November 2026, sekitar 657.000 pada 8 November, sekitar 1,6 juta pada 9 November, dan sekitar 2,2 juta dalam 24 jam hingga 10 November pukul 07.30 WIB. Sekitar 1 juta di antaranya menyasar sektor keuangan. (Bisnis.com, Gebrak.id, Fortune IDN, Katadata)
  • Alfons Tanujaya dari Vaksincom menjelaskan bahwa angka tersebut adalah upaya serangan yang terdeteksi dan diblokir sensor Fortinet, “bukan jumlah sistem yang berhasil dibobol”. (Bisnis.com)
  • BSSN menerbitkan Security Advisory pada 8 November. Ancaman yang beredar dikaitkan dengan penolakan terhadap SPP-TDLN, kebijakan pajak transaksi digital luar negeri, dan belum terverifikasi. (Katadata)
  • Komdigi mengirim tiga surat imbauan pada 9 November kepada pengguna PDN dan Cloud Pemerintah, pengelola domain instansi, serta PSE lingkup publik. Aries Kusdaryono menegaskan, “Kita tidak boleh mengabaikan potensi risiko ancaman serangan tersebut.” (Katadata)
  • OJK dan BI mengaktifkan Tim Tanggap Insiden Siber (TTIS) dan meminta bank menahan transaksi yang anomali untuk diverifikasi. (The Star / The Jakarta Post)
articles.analysisHtml:
1. Angka dashboard adalah telemetri satu vendor, bukan jumlah insiden

Dashboard FortiGuard menghitung lalu lintas mencurigakan yang terlihat oleh sensor Fortinet. Besar kecilnya angka dipengaruhi jumlah perangkat yang terpasang dan cara log dihitung. Angka ini lebih tepat dibaca sebagai “suhu” internet Indonesia, bukan daftar korban. Lonjakan enam kali lipat dalam tiga hari biasanya berarti pemindaian otomatis sedang meningkat tajam.

2. Separuh serangan memakai celah lama dari tahun 2021

Pada 9 November, serangan yang memanfaatkan celah Apache Log4j tercatat sekitar 774.000 kali, atau 53% dari total. Log4j adalah kerentanan yang diumumkan pada akhir 2021. Sebagian besar lalu lintas ini adalah pemindaian massal yang mencari server yang belum ditambal, bukan serangan canggih yang menargetkan satu bank.

3. Masalah sebenarnya: 96,7% server .co.id yang terdeteksi memakai PHP kedaluwarsa

Pemindaian Vaksincom per 23 Oktober 2026 menemukan 4.650 server .co.id yang versi PHP-nya terbaca. Sebanyak 4.495 di antaranya (96,7%) memakai versi yang sudah tidak mendapat pembaruan keamanan. Hanya 0,2% server PHP yang terdeteksi sudah menambal celah kritis PHP2Shell. Situs perusahaan, portal pelanggan, dan sistem lama yang terhubung ke internet adalah pintu masuk yang paling mungkin.

4. Pola hacktivisme: yang diincar perhatian publik, bukan uang

Senjata khas hacktivis adalah DDoS dan deface pada target yang terlihat publik. Sistem inti perbankan jarang menjadi korban kampanye semacam ini. Namun, aplikasi dan situs yang menghadap publik bisa terganggu, dan itu cukup untuk merusak reputasi.

5. Gelombang kedua: penipuan yang menunggangi kepanikan

Berita besar soal serangan siber biasanya diikuti phishing yang menyamar sebagai pemberitahuan bank. Bank Indonesia sebelumnya memproyeksikan kerugian akibat serangan siber di Indonesia mencapai sekitar US$6,2 miliar pada 2026.
articles.actionHtml:
Untuk CIO dan CISO

  1. Inventarisasi semua sistem yang menghadap internet, termasuk subdomain yang terlupakan.
  2. Perbarui PHP, Java (Log4j), dan CMS yang kedaluwarsa, mulai dari sistem yang menyimpan data pelanggan.
  3. Aktifkan proteksi DDoS dan WAF pada situs dan API publik.
  4. Wajibkan MFA untuk semua akun administrator.
  5. Uji pemulihan dari backup, bukan hanya memastikan backup ada.
  6. Siapkan pesan resmi untuk pelanggan agar penipu tidak mengisi kekosongan informasi.

OJK sudah mewajibkan bank menjalankan uji penetrasi, simulasi serangan, dan audit teknologi secara rutin. RUU Keamanan dan Ketahanan Siber juga masuk Prolegnas Prioritas 2026. Keamanan siber kini menjadi urusan direksi.

Untuk penyedia solusi keamanan

Kebutuhan paling mendesak ada di empat area: modernisasi aplikasi web dan patch management, proteksi DDoS dan WAF, SOC dan Managed Detection & Response, serta anti-fraud dan edukasi phishing. Pendekatan yang efektif bukan menakut-nakuti dengan angka 2,2 juta, melainkan menawarkan pemeriksaan cepat atas sistem yang menghadap internet.
articles.faqHtml:
Apakah 2,2 juta serangan berarti 2,2 juta sistem diretas?

Tidak. Angka itu adalah percobaan serangan yang terdeteksi dan diblokir sensor FortiGuard Labs dalam 24 jam.

Apakah dana nasabah bank aman?

OJK dan BI telah mengaktifkan tim tanggap insiden. Nasabah diminta tetap bertransaksi seperti biasa melalui kanal resmi bank.

Apa langkah pertama yang perlu dilakukan perusahaan?

Periksa dan perbarui semua sistem yang menghadap internet, terutama yang memakai PHP, Java, atau CMS versi lama.

en.title: 2.2 Million Cyberattacks on Indonesia in 24 Hours: Reading the Numbers Behind the Panic
en.dek: Attempted cyberattacks on Indonesia shown on the FortiGuard Labs dashboard rose from about 350,600 to 2.2 million in three days. The number is real, but it is not a count of breached systems. The biggest risk for companies lies elsewhere.
en.dataLabel: attempted cyberattacks on Indonesia in 24 hours
en.dataSource: FortiGuard Labs dashboard, 24-hour snapshot as of 10 November 2026
en.seoTitle: 2.2M Cyberattacks on Indonesia: What It Means for Banks
en.seoDescription: FortiGuard's count jumped from 350,000 to 2.2 million in three days. What actually happened, and the steps Indonesian companies should take now.
en.summaryHtml:
• The FortiGuard Labs dashboard recorded about 350,600 attempted attacks in the 24 hours to 7 November 2026, about 657,000 on 8 November, about 1.6 million on 9 November and about 2.2 million in the 24 hours to 07:30 WIB on 10 November. About 1 million of them targeted the financial sector. (Bisnis.com, Gebrak.id, Fortune IDN, Katadata)
  • Alfons Tanujaya of Vaksincom explained that the figure counts attack attempts detected and blocked by Fortinet sensors, “not the number of systems that were breached”. (Bisnis.com)
  • BSSN issued a Security Advisory on 8 November. The threats in circulation are linked to opposition to SPP-TDLN, a tax policy on foreign digital transactions, and have not been verified. (Katadata)
  • Komdigi sent three advisory letters on 9 November to users of the National Data Center and Government Cloud, government domain managers and public-sector electronic system operators. Aries Kusdaryono stressed that the potential risk of these attacks must not be ignored. (Katadata)
  • OJK and Bank Indonesia activated the Cyber Incident Response Team (TTIS) and asked banks to hold anomalous transactions for verification. (The Star / The Jakarta Post)
en.analysisHtml:
1. The dashboard figure is one vendor's telemetry, not an incident count

The FortiGuard dashboard counts suspicious traffic seen by Fortinet sensors. The size of the number depends on how many devices are installed and how logs are counted. It is better read as the “temperature” of Indonesia's internet than as a list of victims. A sixfold jump in three days usually means automated scanning is rising sharply.

2. Half of the attacks used an old flaw from 2021

On 9 November, attacks exploiting the Apache Log4j flaw were recorded about 774,000 times, or 53% of the total. Log4j is a vulnerability disclosed at the end of 2021. Most of this traffic is mass scanning for unpatched servers, not a sophisticated attack aimed at one bank.

3. The real problem: 96.7% of detected .co.id servers run outdated PHP

A Vaksincom scan as of 23 October 2026 found 4,650 .co.id servers whose PHP version could be read. Of these, 4,495 (96.7%) run versions that no longer receive security updates. Only 0.2% of the detected PHP servers had patched the critical PHP2Shell flaw. Company websites, customer portals and legacy systems connected to the internet are the most likely entry points.

4. The hacktivist pattern: the target is public attention, not money

Hacktivists typically use DDoS and website defacement against highly visible targets. Core banking systems are rarely the victims of such campaigns. Public-facing applications and websites can still be disrupted, and that is enough to damage a reputation.

5. The second wave: fraud riding on the panic

Big news about cyberattacks is usually followed by phishing disguised as bank notifications. Bank Indonesia had earlier projected losses from cyberattacks in Indonesia of about US$6.2 billion in 2026.
en.actionHtml:
For CIOs and CISOs

  1. Inventory every internet-facing system, including forgotten subdomains.
  2. Update outdated PHP, Java (Log4j) and CMS installations, starting with systems that hold customer data.
  3. Turn on DDoS protection and a WAF for public websites and APIs.
  4. Require MFA for every administrator account.
  5. Test restoring from backup, not just that backups exist.
  6. Prepare official customer messages so that fraudsters cannot fill the information gap.

OJK already requires banks to run regular penetration tests, attack simulations and technology audits. The Cyber Security and Resilience Bill is also on the 2026 Priority National Legislation Program. Cybersecurity is now a board-level matter.

For security solution providers

The most urgent needs are in four areas: web application modernization and patch management, DDoS protection and WAF, SOC and Managed Detection & Response, and anti-fraud and phishing education. The effective approach is not to scare buyers with the 2.2 million figure but to offer a quick check of their internet-facing systems.
en.faqHtml:
Do 2.2 million attacks mean 2.2 million systems were hacked?

No. The figure counts attack attempts detected and blocked by FortiGuard Labs sensors over 24 hours.

Are bank customers' funds safe?

OJK and Bank Indonesia have activated an incident response team. Customers are asked to keep transacting as usual through the banks' official channels.

What should a company do first?

Check and update every internet-facing system, especially those running old versions of PHP, Java or a CMS.
